Meanwhile, y will likely be heavily contested by others despite my high priority there.

Since I can't improve my outcome by strategic misreporting under a strategy-proof mechanism, and my true preferences already align favorably given the crowd's preferences (less competition for z, my favorite), the best approach is to submit my true preference ordering.
